tools.name: get_onboarding_instructions
tools.description:
Get API-key setup and integration instructions before your first PumpView call.

        Public: no key or data credits needed. Returns dashboard/Agent Kit/docs URLs,
        ordered HTTP wallet-challenge steps, and separate trading/data workflows.
        Does not create an account, sign, pay or tr

tools.name: get_trading_config
tools.description:
Read the current server's swap policy before choosing build_swap parameters.

        Public: no API key or data credits needed. Returns enabled, mint aliases,
        allowed pair assets, fee basis points, USD minimums, tip limits and build TTL.
        enabled is configuration status, not a liquid

tools.name: build_swap
tools.description:
Build and simulate an unsigned ExactIn swap, without spending funds.

        Requires a Bearer API key and its linked wallet, but no data subscription or
        credits. Check get_trading_config first. At least one leg must be SOL/WSOL or
        USDC; minimum value is $5 unless Unlimited is activ

tools.name: get_trading_usage
tools.description:
Read all-time executed volume for the authenticated account and each API key.

        Use for accounting, not market history (get_recent_trades) or one receipt
        (get_swap_status). Bearer key required; no data package or credits consumed.
        Returns available, totals and by_api_key. Succ

tools.name: submit_swap
tools.description:
Broadcast the wallet-approved, signed build through Kolibrio. This can spend funds.

        Requires a Bearer key for the account that built the swap. Only the exact
        build_swap message is accepted; the wallet must already have reviewed and
        authorized its amounts and costs. Returns t

tools.name: get_swap_status
tools.description:
Check an existing account swap after submission, including after a timeout.

        Requires the owning account's Bearer key; no data credits consumed. Returns
        id, signature, status and receipt. States are built, submitted, confirmed,
        finalized, failed or expired. Execution receipts

tools.name: get_recent_trades
tools.description:
Read filtered market swap summaries from PumpView's supported SOL-pair feed.

        Use for recent market activity, not your submitted swap receipt (get_swap_status).
        Requires a Bearer key, active data grant and sufficient key budget. Each call
        consumes max(1, returned event count)

tools.name: get_access_status
tools.description:
Inspect the authenticated account's live-data grants, rate limit and feed health.

        Call before consuming data or after an access error. Bearer key required;
        no data credits consumed. Returns unexpired grants (remaining=-1 means
        Unlimited), http_rate_limit shared across accoun

tools.name: get_payment_instructions
tools.description:
Create a new unpaid USDC invoice for a live-data package; this spends no funds.

        Call only after choosing a current plan with list_data_plans and checking get_access_status.
        Trading alone needs no data subscription. Requires a Bearer key and linked
        Solana wallet; missing wall

tools.name: list_data_plans
tools.description:
List current data packages and prices before buying a live-data subscription.

        Public: no key or credits needed. Returns plan IDs, price in atomic USDC
        (6 decimals), duration, event allowance, filters, account request/connection
        limits and sales_enabled. -1 credits means Unli

tools.name: get_invoice_status
tools.description:
Read one of your account's existing invoices without creating or paying another.

        Bearer key required; no package or data credits needed. Returns payer,
        recipient, exact atomic USDC amount, memo, expires (Unix seconds) and paid.
        paid=false means not yet settled by PumpView, n

tools.name: prepare_invoice_payment
tools.description:
Prepare an unsigned USDC payment for an existing unpaid, unexpired invoice.

        Bearer key required; no package or data credits needed. Returns a base64
        legacy Solana transaction and last_valid_block_height. Review it against
        get_invoice_status: payer, recipient, mint, amount an

tools.name: confirm_invoice_payment
tools.description:
Verify an already-broadcast invoice payment and activate the purchased data package.

        Bearer key for the invoice owner required; no data credits consumed. Reads
        Solana at finalized and validates payer, recipient, USDC amount, memo and
        payment window. It never broadcasts a pay

tools.name: get_stream_connection
tools.description:
Get WSS setup for continuous live trades instead of polling get_recent_trades.

        Requires a Bearer key with an active eligible data grant/budget; 402 means
        access is unavailable. Returns url, an Authorization header template,
        first_message JSON and cursor-resume instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_onboarding_instructions, build_swap, get_recent_trades, get_access_status, get_payment_instructions, prepare_invoice_payment, get_stream_connection · Private data: get_onboarding_instructions, get_trading_config, build_swap, get_trading_usage, submit_swap, get_recent_trades, get_payment_instructions, get_invoice_status, prepare_invoice_payment · Public sink: submit_swap, get_payment_instructions, get_invoice_status, prepare_invoice_payment, confirm_invoice_payment, get_stream_connection.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_onboarding_instructions, build_swap, get_recent_trades, get_access_status, get_payment_instructions, prepare_invoice_payment, get_stream_connection · Private data: get_onboarding_instructions, get_trading_config, build_swap, get_trading_usage, submit_swap, get_recent_trades, get_payment_instructions, get_invoice_status, prepare_invoice_payment · Public sink: submit_swap, get_payment_instructions, get_invoice_status, prepare_invoice_payment, confirm_invoice_payment, get_stream_connection

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
